notes: Plan 7 Track S draft (for the designer's review; docs/notes/spells-review.md). The arcane pool (wizards) and the divine pool (clerics; paladins and rangers draw from its levels 1-5), levels 1-9. Names echo SRD 5.1 spells; the descriptions and numbers are ours. Each divine level holds one Calling, whose summon depends on the caster's alignment (summons.json). The combat engine does not cast spells yet. Revised after the designer’s review 2026-11-14 (docs/notes/spells-review.md, "Revisions 2026-11-14"): shorter ranges, Mage Armor for Shield, Mass Dominate, the push and pull spells, hazards that hurt only at the start of a turn. Damage is fixed by the spell level: nothing scales with the caster’s level.

entries.name: Magic Missile
entries.description: Three darts of pale force curl past any guard and strike home.

entries.name: Burning Hands
entries.description: A fan of flame from spread fingers scorches everyone on the next tile.

entries.name: Thunderwave
entries.description: A thunderclap bruises the nearest foes and throws them back a tile.

entries.name: Chromatic Orb
entries.description: A hurled sphere of raw element: a heavy blow, if it lands.

entries.name: Mage Armor
entries.description: A close-fitting skin of force settles over the caster and holds until the fight is done.

entries.name: Sleep
entries.description: A drowsy hush falls on one tile; whoever gives in to it loses a turn.

entries.name: Grease
entries.description: The ground turns slick: those who fail can only scramble where they stand.

entries.name: Fog Cloud
entries.description: A bank of fog settles on one tile and hides all within it from aimed blows.

entries.name: Scorching Ray
entries.description: Lances of fire from an open palm, all poured into one foe.

entries.name: Shatter
entries.description: A ringing note splits stone and bone on one tile far down the line.

entries.name: Acid Arrow
entries.description: A green arrow that burns on impact and eats at armour for a while after.

entries.name: Cloud of Daggers
entries.description: A whirl of conjured blades hangs over one tile and cuts whoever starts a turn in it.

entries.name: Hold Person
entries.description: One foe is locked rigid where it stands for two turns.

entries.name: Misty Step
entries.description: A step into silver mist, and out of it three tiles away, untouched.

entries.name: Blindness
entries.description: Darkness clamps over one foe's eyes: it swings wild and cannot aim past arm's reach.

entries.name: Gust of Wind
entries.description: A howling gale shoves everyone on one tile two tiles back.

entries.name: Shove
entries.description: An unseen hand shoves one creature, friend or foe, two tiles toward the caster or away.

entries.name: Fireball
entries.description: A bead of fire that blooms over two tiles. Mind where your friends stand.

entries.name: Lightning Bolt
entries.description: A crack of lightning down the line, all of its force on one tile.

entries.name: Hungry Dark
entries.description: A starless cold spreads over two tiles: inside it nothing sees, and everything freezes.

entries.name: Slow
entries.description: Time thickens around the foes on two tiles: they plod, fumble and leave gaps.

entries.name: Haste
entries.description: One ally moves in a blur: an extra action each round, and harder to hit.

entries.name: Fear
entries.description: A glimpse of their own deaths sends the foes on one tile backing away.

entries.name: Bestow Curse
entries.description: A touch and a muttered word: every blow the foe takes bites deeper.

entries.name: Ice Storm
entries.description: Hail the size of fists batters two tiles and leaves the ground treacherous.

entries.name: Blight
entries.description: Life drains out of one foe like sap from a cut stalk.

entries.name: Wall of Fire
entries.description: A sheet of roaring flame on one tile: nothing crosses it, and whatever starts a turn in it burns.

entries.name: Black Tentacles
entries.description: Black limbs rise from the ground, drag the foes on one tile two tiles nearer and hold them there.

entries.name: Greater Invisibility
entries.description: One ally vanishes: blows go astray, and their own come out of nowhere.

entries.name: Banishment
entries.description: One foe is sent elsewhere for a while. If the fight lasts, it comes back angry.

entries.name: Stoneskin
entries.description: Skin turns hard as granite: every blow the ally takes is blunted, all fight long.

entries.name: Cone of Cold
entries.description: A blast of killing frost over the two nearest tiles.

entries.name: Cloudkill
entries.description: A yellow-green fog of poison settles over two tiles and will not lift.

entries.name: Wall of Force
entries.description: An unseen, unbreakable pane on one tile cuts the line in two.

entries.name: Dominate Person
entries.description: One foe's will bends to the caster's: for a while it turns its blows on its own.

entries.name: Telekinesis
entries.description: An unseen hand plucks one foe off its feet and drags it three tiles closer.

entries.name: Repelling Wave
entries.description: A wall of unseen force rolls down the line and sweeps everyone on one tile three tiles back.

entries.name: Veil of Mirrors
entries.description: Every member doubles and shimmers; the foes' blows find only reflections.

entries.name: Chain Lightning
entries.description: Lightning leaps from foe to foe across two tiles far down the line.

entries.name: Disintegrate
entries.description: A thin green ray: whatever it touches, and fails to dodge, falls away as dust.

entries.name: Globe of Invulnerability
entries.description: A shimmering dome over one tile: those inside shrug off most of what strikes them.

entries.name: Flesh to Stone
entries.description: One foe greys and stiffens into a statue: still, and easy to chip.

entries.name: Mass Suggestion
entries.description: A single reasonable word, "leave", and the foes on two tiles start backing off.

entries.name: True Seeing
entries.description: Every member sees through shadow and feint: each foe's guard lies open.

entries.name: Undertow
entries.description: A drowning current of force seizes one far foe, batters it and drags it four tiles in.

entries.name: Crashing Wave
entries.description: A conjured breaker of grey water smashes over two tiles and hurls the foes two tiles back.

entries.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
entries.description: A swelling bead of fire bursts over two tiles with twice the fury of its lesser kin and throws the foes back.

entries.name: Finger of Death
entries.description: A pointed finger and a word of unmaking: the foe withers from within.

entries.name: Forcecage
entries.description: Bars of force shut in everyone on one tile: they can neither act nor be harmed.

entries.name: Reverse Gravity
entries.description: Over two tiles down becomes up: the foes there fall into the sky and lose a turn.

entries.name: Teleport
entries.description: The whole party is somewhere else, all at once. The fight is left behind.

entries.name: Sunburst
entries.description: Noon erupts over two tiles: it burns, and leaves the survivors seeing only white.

entries.name: Power Word Stun
entries.description: One spoken word, and one foe stands dazed for two turns. No save.

entries.name: Maze
entries.description: One foe is hurled into a labyrinth between worlds and comes back battered and bewildered.

entries.name: Mass Dominate
entries.description: For one turn the foes on a tile answer to the caster, and turn their blows on their own.

entries.name: Demiplane
entries.description: A door onto a quiet grey room: one ally steps through, out of harm, and comes back rested and sharp.

entries.name: Meteor Swarm
entries.description: Burning stones fall from a clear sky onto two tiles. Little stands afterwards.

entries.name: Time Stop
entries.description: The world holds its breath for everyone but the party: each member acts once more.

entries.name: Foresight
entries.description: One ally sees each moment a heartbeat before it comes, all fight long.

entries.name: Imprisonment
entries.description: One foe is bound away in a prison of the caster's choosing for the rest of the fight.

entries.name: Singularity
entries.description: A point of crushing dark opens before the caster: everything on two tiles is torn toward it, three tiles in.

entries.name: Healing Word
entries.description: A word of comfort carried down the line closes a wound without breaking stride.

entries.name: Bless
entries.description: A blessing on one ally steadies their hand for three rounds.

entries.name: Bane
entries.description: A muttered curse makes the foes on one tile doubt every swing.

entries.name: Guiding Bolt
entries.description: A bolt of light strikes hard and leaves the foe glowing for the next blow.

entries.name: Inflict Wounds
entries.description: A touch that tears flesh open from within.

entries.name: Hail of Thorns
entries.description: An arrow bursts into a spray of thorns over one distant tile.

entries.name: Briar Lash
entries.description: A thorned vine lashes out, bites in and drags one foe a tile closer.

entries.name: First Calling
entries.description: A spirit hound bounds in to fight beside the party; the dark-sworn raise a skeleton archer.

entries.name: Spiritual Weapon
entries.description: A weapon of light at the caster’s side strikes a foe beside them at a word, leaving the caster free to act.

entries.name: Heat Metal
entries.description: One foe's arms or armour glow red-hot: it burns, and fights clumsily.

entries.name: Moonbeam
entries.description: A pale column of moonlight on one tile sears whoever starts a turn in it.

entries.name: Spike Growth
entries.description: The ground over two tiles sprouts hidden thorns: whoever starts a turn there bleeds.

entries.name: Aid
entries.description: Hope and grit: one ally gains hit points that last the fight.

entries.name: Shield of Faith
entries.description: A shimmer of faith around one ally turns blows aside all fight long.

entries.name: Command
entries.description: One word of command, "Back!", and the foe gives up two tiles.

entries.name: Shepherd’s Crook
entries.description: A crook of light hooks one creature, friend or foe, and moves it two tiles nearer or farther.

entries.name: Second Calling
entries.description: A cave bear lumbers out of nowhere to fight for the party; the dark-sworn call a ghoul.

entries.name: Spirit Guardians
entries.description: Spirits wheel over the tile before the caster and tear at every foe who starts a turn there.

entries.name: Call Lightning
entries.description: A storm cloud gathers and drops its lightning on one tile far down the line.

entries.name: Lightning Arrow
entries.description: An arrow turns to lightning in flight and strikes one far foe.

entries.name: Revivify
entries.description: A touch and a prayer bring a fallen ally back to their feet, barely.

entries.name: Mass Healing Word
entries.description: A ringing word of comfort closes a wound on every member at once.

entries.name: Crusader's Mantle
entries.description: A holy fervour spreads through the party: every blow lands harder.

entries.name: Third Calling
entries.description: A great stag of the old woods answers and rallies the party; the dark-sworn raise an ogre zombie.

entries.name: Guardian of Faith
entries.description: A towering spectral guardian holds one tile: no foe gets past, and those who linger by it suffer.

entries.name: Withering Prayer
entries.description: A prayer of unmaking dries one foe out from within.

entries.name: Staggering Smite
entries.description: A blow wreathed in holy wrath that lands hard and leaves the foe reeling.

entries.name: Rebuke the Wicked
entries.description: A raised holy symbol blazes, and the foes on one tile shrink back from it.

entries.name: Aura of Purity
entries.description: A clean, cool light around the party: every blow on them is softened.

entries.name: Grasping Vine
entries.description: A vine bursts from the earth, coils round one foe and hauls it three tiles in.

entries.name: Call of the Fold
entries.description: A bell only the soul hears tolls, and the foes on one tile stumble two tiles toward it.

entries.name: Fourth Calling
entries.description: A unicorn steps out of the light to fight for the party; the dark-sworn call a wight.

entries.name: Flame Strike
entries.description: A column of holy fire roars down on one tile.

entries.name: Insect Plague
entries.description: A biting swarm of locusts settles on two tiles and stays.

entries.name: Mass Cure Wounds
entries.description: A wave of healing washes over every member.

entries.name: Hallow
entries.description: The tile is made holy: the allies standing on it fight better and are harder to hit.

entries.name: Swift Quiver
entries.description: Arrows leap to hand faster than thought: an extra action each round for a while.

entries.name: Tree Stride
entries.description: Into one tree, out of another: the caster steps up to four tiles away, untouched.

entries.name: Fifth Calling
entries.description: A feathered serpent of the heavens coils in to fight; the dark-sworn call a wraith.

entries.name: Harm
entries.description: A touch that fills one foe with a sudden, wasting sickness.

entries.name: Heal
entries.description: A surge of healing that makes one ally nearly whole.

entries.name: Blade Barrier
entries.description: A whirling wall of blades on one tile: nothing crosses, and whatever starts a turn in it is cut apart.

entries.name: Word of Recall
entries.description: One word, and the party stands in its last safe camp. The fight is left behind.

entries.name: Heroes' Feast
entries.description: A blessed meal shared in a moment: every member stands taller for the whole fight.

entries.name: Sixth Calling
entries.description: A deva descends to lead the party; the dark-sworn raise a mummy.

entries.name: Fire Storm
entries.description: Sheets of fire roll over two tiles at the caster's command.

entries.name: Divine Word
entries.description: A word of the gods' own tongue: the foes on one tile reel, deaf, blind and still.

entries.name: Regenerate
entries.description: Flesh knits and keeps knitting: a deep heal, and a body that shrugs off small cuts.

entries.name: Plane Shift
entries.description: A touch with a tuning fork, and one foe is sent to another world for the rest of the fight.

entries.name: Sunbeam
entries.description: A beam of noon light down the line: it burns one tile and dazzles all on it.

entries.name: Seventh Calling
entries.description: A roc stoops from the sky to fight for the party; the dark-sworn raise a bone sorcerer.

entries.name: Earthquake
entries.description: The ground heaves under two tiles: the foes there are battered and thrown off balance.

entries.name: Holy Aura
entries.description: A soft radiance around every member makes the foes' blows slip aside.

entries.name: Hymn of Battle
entries.description: A war hymn carried by unseen voices: every member strikes truer and harder.

entries.name: Sympathy
entries.description: A deep longing draws the foes on two tiles three tiles toward the caster.

entries.name: Eighth Calling
entries.description: A planetar strides onto the line to fight for the party; the dark-sworn raise a grave knight.

entries.name: Mass Heal
entries.description: A flood of healing light leaves every member nearly whole.

entries.name: Storm of Vengeance
entries.description: A churning black storm breaks over two tiles: thunder, acid, hail and lightning.

entries.name: True Resurrection
entries.description: Every fallen member rises, whole enough to fight on.

entries.name: Ninth Calling
entries.description: A solar answers, bow in hand; the dark-sworn raise a dragon of bare bone.
